::: {#cor-residual-prediction-error}
#### The residual is the negative of the prediction error

For an observation $i$,
its [residual](#def-residual) is the negative of
the [prediction error](#def-prediction-error) of its [fitted value](#def-fitted-value):

$$\resid_i = -\prederr_i.$$
:::

::: proof
Multiply both sides of @thm-prediction-error-residual by $-1$.
:::
